findingClass: a post-scrape step fails every cycle, hidden by its non-fatal catch, while the cycle keeps exiting 0
failThreshold: any step in the derived STEP_NAMES whose most recent scraper_steps rows show status=failed for >= 3 consecutive cycles (leading streak, newest-first). 2 is a blip and PASSes; a non-failed row ends the streak.
unverifiableWhen: same as k_step_ledger_silence — unparseable STEP_NAMES, missing scraper_steps table, or an empty 24h window
